descriptions.zh-Hans: 纽约H&H贝果早餐留下的菜单。我选了奶油奶酪，旁边写着吃完最先想到的一句话。
descriptions.en: A menu from my H&H bagel breakfast in New York. Cream cheese was my choice; the note preserves my first thought afterwards.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在纽约Joe’s吃过切片披萨后画的小菜单。两个对话框之间，是我和旅人暂停说话吃午饭的空当。
descriptions.en: Drawn after a slice at Joe’s in New York. Two speech bubbles leave space for the lunch that interrupted our conversation.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在纽约布鲁克林大桥歇脚时写的便签。“过河”旁边留着一行，等脚步的声音经过。
descriptions.en: My note from a rest on the Brooklyn Bridge in New York. Beside “across the river,” a line waits for passing footsteps.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 纽约披萨午饭后自己留的小纸条。两段没讲完的话，都在等下一口吃完。
descriptions.en: A homemade note from my New York pizza lunch. Two pieces of conversation wait patiently between bites.

names.en: A Look Back at Bow Bridge

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在纽约中央公园看弓桥时，我给自己的散步留了一句提醒：走过以后也可以回头看。
descriptions.en: My reminder from Bow Bridge in New York’s Central Park: a walk may include looking back.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在纽约布鲁克林大桥边听见的快慢，变成了纸上长短不同的线。这张卡记录一次自己的停步，不是桥上的乐谱。
descriptions.en: Short and long lines recall the changing pace I heard on the Brooklyn Bridge in New York. A record of my own pause, rather than a score for the bridge.
